Adjacent span[data-as=p] elements convert like paragraphs

```swift title="Swift"
import HtmlToMarkdown

let _options = try HtmlToMarkdown.conversionOptionsFromJson("{}")
let result = try HtmlToMarkdown.convert(html: "<div><span data-as=\"p\">First paragraph.</span><span data-as=\"p\">Second paragraph.</span></div>", options: _options)
debugPrint(result.content as Any)
```
